reply.shortGloss: to go; to be (health/fit); to fit
reply.emotion: moving forward purposefully, ready to get moving
notes: Aller is one of the most common irregular verbs in French, changing completely to vais, vas, va, allons, allez, vont in the present tense.
It is also used as an auxiliary verb to form the near future tense (futur composé), as in 'je vais manger'.

senses.definition: Se déplacer d'un endroit vers un autre.

examples.translation: I am going to the station.
examples.emotion: focused and determined, heading out the door

senses.definition: Être dans tel ou tel état de santé ou d'humeur.

examples.emotion: warm and friendly, greeting a friend

senses.definition: Convenir à quelqu'un, en parlant d'un vêtement.

examples.text: Cette chemise te va très bien.
examples.translation: This shirt suits you very well.
examples.emotion: approving and encouraging, checking out a new look in the mirror
